_comment: Per-region terrain config. Heightmap is a grayscale PNG; pixel 0 maps to height_min meters, pixel 255 to height_max. world_extent is the side length in meters (square region centered at world_origin). Subdivide controls mesh density (verts per side); 64 = 4m per quad at 256m extent, fine for inner Wood. Keep in sync with scripts/gen_terrain_heightmap.py defaults.
